intro.header: Equations with Unknowns on Both Sides
intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 1  Choose the side to keep the letters
2  Subtract the smaller letter term (both sides)
commonMistakes: Not doing the move to both sides.
Moving the larger letter term and creating a needless negative.
Stopping at ax = c without the final division.
intro.visualAid: Balance scale with x-tiles and unit-tiles on both pans. Remove 3 x-tiles from each pan, then remove 2 units from each pan, leaving 2x = 8 → x = 4.

questions.content: Sara (4x+2) sweets = Tom (6x−8) sweets. a) Equation. b) Find x. c) How many each?
Plan A: £10 + £2/GB. Plan B: £4 + £4/GB. a) Equation in g. b) GB where equal. c) That cost.
Rod A (5x−3) cm = Rod B (2x+9) cm. a) Find x. b) Length of each. c) Rod 5 cm less than twice Rod A.
